test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Consider the following pairs:

 
 

 
 
**Area of Cooperation**

 
 
 
**India–Italy Partnership**

 
 
 

 
 
I.Clean energy

 
 
 
Included

 
 
 

 
 
II.Mobility of workers

 
 
 
Included

 
 
 

 
 
III.Arctic governance

 
 
 
Included as a central pillar

 
 
 

How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and Italy recently expanded cooperation across strategic, economic, and technological sectors under their growing bilateral partnership framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Clean energy cooperation forms part of the India–Italy partnership agenda.Cooperation areas include renewable energy, sustainability, and green-transition initiatives. **Hence, Pair I is correctly matched. **
 
• Mobility and migration partnerships, including facilitation of movement of skilled and non-skilled workers through safe and legal channels, were highlighted in bilateral discussions. **Hence, Pair II is correctly matched. **
 
• Arctic governance was not identified as a central pillar of India–Italy cooperation. The partnership primarily focuses on strategic technologies, trade, clean energy, mobility, defence, and industrial collaboration. **Hence, Pair III is incorrectly matched. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Labour mobility agreements are increasingly important in India’s bilateral diplomacy and workforce strategy.
 
• Clean energy partnerships are linked with climate commitments, technology transfer, and sustainable development goals.
 
• India and Italy have also expanded cooperation in defence manufacturing, critical technologies, and industrial partnerships.
 
• Strategic partnerships increasingly combine economic, technological, and geopolitical dimensions.
